$comment: Parts the harvester must NOT cut, each with the measurement that excluded it. A donor is a whole example VI, and some carry state a plain AIXML control does not have.
fpdco/stdRing/ctl/UnitUInt32: Cut from an NI example: a uint32 enum control on it alone loaded ExecState 0 (8 of 18 broken composed NI VIs had one, mostly tab controls); the clean UnitUInt16 enum part re-typed to UnitUInt32 works (measured 2026-10-10, try e32a).
fpdco/listbox/ctl/Array: Cut from NI's System Mixed Checkbox.vi (both Array-typed listbox parts come from it): a listbox composed with either KILLED LabVIEW on load, alone on its panel, with or without items - NI's Listbox.vi, System Mixed Checkbox.vi and an int32 multicolumn listbox alike. The NumInt32 listbox parts re-typed to the array load executable in all of them (measured 2026-11-06, scratch probes lb3/noarray; docs/aixml-backends.md).
fpdco/listbox/ctl/Array_NumInt32: Cut from NI's System Mixed Checkbox.vi (both Array-typed listbox parts come from it): a listbox composed with either KILLED LabVIEW on load, alone on its panel, with or without items - NI's Listbox.vi, System Mixed Checkbox.vi and an int32 multicolumn listbox alike. The NumInt32 listbox parts re-typed to the array load executable in all of them (measured 2026-11-06, scratch probes lb3/noarray; docs/aixml-backends.md).
fpdco/stdGraph3504/ind/Array.MeasureData: A probe VI holding this graph part alone, typed with the part's own data type, KILLED LabVIEW on load - its panel is not loadable (Cannot load front panel, 1013) - while the double-typed graph parts load executable. Measured 2026-11-06 over all 36 graph parts with an AIXML type (experiments/aixml-without-grpc/graph_part_probes.py); without the part the graph is composed as its plain data type and the VI loads (docs/aixml-backends.md).
